lines.lyric_translation: Marathon, marathon
Life is long, go slow
At the end, there will be a paradise of your dreams
But the real world
Is different from the promises
We need to run, we need to step on others
When the signal is hot
You don’t even have a destination
There’s no landscape
When you’re running out of breath

lines.lyric: You need to you need to
lines.lyric_hangul: You need to you need to
lines.lyric_translation: You need to you need to
It’s alright to stop

lines.lyric: Amu iyudo moreuneun chae dallil piryo eopseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 아무 이유도 모르는 채 달릴 필요 없어
lines.lyric_translation: You don’t need to run without knowing why
It’s alright to not have any dreams

lines.lyric: Jamshi haengbogeul neukkil ne sungandeuri ittamyeon
lines.lyric_hangul: 잠시 행복을 느낄 네 순간들이 있다면
lines.lyric_translation: If you have moments where you can feel happiness
It’s alright to stop

lines.lyric: Ijen mokjeokdo moreuneun chae dalliji ana
lines.lyric_hangul: 이젠 목적도 모르는 채 달리지 않아
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t run without knowing where you’re going anymore
It’s alright to not have any dreams

lines.lyric: Nega naebaetneun modeun hoheubeun imi nakwone
lines.lyric_hangul: 네가 내뱉는 모든 호흡은 이미 낙원에
lines.lyric_translation: All of the air you breathe out is already paradise
We dream from others (like a debt)
We learn that we must become great (like a light)
Your dream is actually baggage
If only the future is a dream

lines.lyric: Naega eojetbam chimdaeseo kkun geon mwo?
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 어젯밤 침대서 꾼 건 뭐?
lines.lyric_translation: What’s the dream I had last night in bed?
It’s alright if your dreams are different
Buying a laptop next month
Or just eating and sleeping

lines.lyric: Amgeotto an haneunde doni maneun geo
lines.lyric_hangul: 암것도 안 하는데 돈이 많은 거
lines.lyric_translation: Having a lot of money by not doing anything
What’s so great about dreams?
Just be who you want
We deserve a life

lines.lyric: Mwoga keugeon jakgeon geunyang neoneun neojaneo
lines.lyric_hangul: 뭐가 크건 작건 그냥 너는 너잖어
lines.lyric_translation: Whether it’s big or small, you’re just doing you
But the real world
Is different from the promises
We need to run, we need to step on others
When the signal is hot
You don’t even have a destination
There’s no landscape
When you’re running out of breath

I don’t have a dream
Sometimes, dreaming is scary
Just living like this

lines.lyric: Saranamneun ge ige naegen jageun kkuminde
lines.lyric_hangul: 살아남는 게 이게 나에겐 작은 꿈인데
lines.lyric_translation: Just surviving is a small dream to me

lines.lyric: Kkumeul kkuneun ge kkumeul jwineun ge
lines.lyric_hangul: 꿈을 꾸는 게 꿈을 쥐는 게
lines.lyric_translation: Dreaming, holding onto that dream
Breathing, sometimes these things are hard
That guy did that, that girl did that
The world tells me as it bashes me
Yeah
The world has no right to bash you
What’s the law for dreams?
No one ever taught us
Because it’s a made-up dream, a tearful sleep talk
Wake up from your nightmare
Just smile for yourself, in that paradise
It’s alright to stop
